start.question: Is the person conscious? (Responds to talk or touch)

unconscious_check.action: IMMEDIATE: Call 112/911. Do not move the victim unless necessary.
unconscious_check.question: Are they breathing normally?

cpr_needed.action: START CPR NOW: 30 chest compressions (2 inches deep, 100-120 bpm), 2 rescue breaths. Repeat until ambulance arrives.
cpr_needed.question: Is there anyone else present to help?

cpr_with_help.action: One person starts CPR. The other calls emergency services and finds an AED (Defibrillator).
cpr_with_help.question: Has an AED arrived?

cpr_alone.action: Call emergency services on speakerphone. Start CPR immediately.
cpr_alone.question: Can you hear the person gasping?

recovery_position.action: Place in recovery position: on their side, head tilted back, mouth downward.
recovery_position.question: Is there visible heavy bleeding?

bleeding_control.action: APPLY PRESSURE: Use cloth/clothing to press firmly on wound. Do not remove. Elevate limb if possible.
bleeding_control.question: Is bleeding from head or neck?

head_bleed.action: Apply direct pressure with clean cloth. Keep head still. Do not apply pressure to neck or eyes.
head_bleed.question: Is the person becoming pale or cold?

limb_bleed.action: Apply direct pressure. If bleeding is life-threatening and pressure fails, use a tourniquet high and tight.
limb_bleed.question: Has the bleeding slowed down?

altered_consciousness.action: Keep person calm. Check for medical alert jewelry. Note any confusion or slurred speech.
altered_consciousness.question: Are they showing stroke signs (Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty)?

stroke_protocol.action: Note time symptoms started. Call 112 immediately. Keep head slightly elevated.
stroke_protocol.question: Are they still conscious?

shock_protocol.action: Lay them flat. Raise legs 12 inches. Cover with a blanket. Do not give anything to drink.
shock_protocol.question: Is their breathing shallow or rapid?

walking_wounded.action: Keep person calm. Clean minor wounds. Seek medical evaluation when possible.
walking_wounded.question: Is there any chest pain or difficulty breathing?

chest_pain_check.action: Sit them down. Loosen tight clothing. If they have nitroglycerin, help them take it.
chest_pain_check.question: Does pain radiate to arm or jaw?

heart_attack_protocol.action: Call 112 immediately. Keep them still. Be prepared to start CPR if they collapse.
heart_attack_protocol.question: Is the person still awake?

aed_use.action: Turn on AED and follow voice prompts. Do not touch victim while AED analyzes rhythm.
aed_use.question: Did AED advise a shock?

aed_shock.action: Ensure no one is touching the victim. Press Shock button. Resume CPR immediately after shock.
aed_shock.question: Is the person moving or responding?

monitor_breathing.action: Stay with them. Check breathing every 2 minutes. Keep them warm.
monitor_breathing.question: Did their condition worsen?

stable_monitor.action: Situation stabilized. Continue monitoring until professional help arrives.
stable_monitor.question: Are there special hazards (EV fire, Chemical spill, Heatstroke)?

final_wait.action: Stay with them. Do not leave until help arrives.
final_wait.question: Has help arrived?

special_hazards.question: Is an Electric Vehicle (EV) involved in fire or smoking?

hazmat_query.question: Is there a chemical spill or colored hazardous material signs?

heat_query.question: Are there signs of heatstroke (Hot, dry skin, confusion)?

ev_fire_check.action: EV FIRE: Retreat 50ft+. Battery fires release toxic gas and can restart. Use ONLY class D or tons of water. DO NOT approach if smoking.
ev_fire_check.question: Is the battery venting/hissing?

ev_venting.action: DANGER: Battery runaway imminent. Clear area. Alert fire services specifically it is an EV.
ev_venting.question: Is everyone at safe distance?

hazmat_check.action: HAZMAT: Identify placards (colored diamonds). Stay UPWIND. Do not touch spilled fluids.
hazmat_check.question: Are there colored diamond signs on the vehicle?

hazmat_placard.action: Note the 4-digit number on the placard. Report this to emergency services immediately.
hazmat_placard.question: Can you safely see the number?

heat_exhaustion_check.action: HEATSTROKE: Move to shade. Cool with water on skin/clothing. Fan vigorously. Sip water if conscious.
heat_exhaustion_check.question: Is the person very hot and NOT sweating?

heatstroke_protocol.action: IMMEDIATE COOLING: Use ice packs on armpits/groin if available. This is a life-threatening emergency.
heatstroke_protocol.question: Is their mental state confused?
